name: quanti-hr
description: Quanti HR — attendance, leave, employee records and manager approvals
overridesNote: React refuses to start when react and react-dom differ by even a patch version,
and it fails as a blank white page rather than a build error, so it is easy to
mistake for a broken app. npm was hoisting react 19.2.8 transitively while
expo install pinned react-dom to 19.2.3. Pinning both keeps one copy in the tree.
Keep these in step with the versions the installed Expo SDK bundles.
